about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Fourth Sunday of Lent” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Grant us, we beseech Thee, merciful God, that we may treat Thy holy things, wherewith we are ceaselessly filled, with sincere devotion, and ever receive them with a faithful mind. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
